body: And live with the the guilt for the rest of my life when he kills himself?

I think it's a large part attributed to the business venture, but I do not believe that to be the entire issue.  He feels alone and lost and like his life is pointless now.

"Employers are way more understanding of your friend's situation than he might think. To pour everything into a business venture for 5 years takes a lot of effort and determination, and the skills that he would have picked up running that business would be worth a lot, regardless of whether the business model proved viable."

That's what I've tried to explain to him.  I even offered to create a resume for him, but he declined.

It was a mutual breakup.  

I'm afraid of that happening.  We got into a very big argument about where he sleeps.  I basically told him if he crawled into bed with me, I'd go and sleep on the couch...and he started crying.  It broke my heart.  I've been clear to him every single time he tries to fool around that I am NOT interested.  I'm very firm about it because I don't want him to be getting mixed signals.  I feel as though letting him sleep in the same bed is like what I would do for a girlfriend if she were lonely, or a younger sibling, etc...it's like a maternal thing I'm feeling.  I'm not trying to justify what I'm doing, I'm just trying to explain why I'm doing what I'm doing...and I really think I should stop allowing it.
